prompt: Create a bright, candid photorealistic summer beach portrait of a smiling young adult Japanese woman leaning slightly forward toward the camera under a clear blue sky. She has short tousled dark bob hair with windblown strands across her forehead, warm natural makeup, and a joyful open smile. She wears a simple white spaghetti-strap camisole and a high-waisted pale blue flowing floral skirt that billows dramatically in the sea breeze. Her hands gather the skirt modestly at the front while the fabric lifts and ripples around her, creating a dynamic sense of motion. Place her on a sandy beach with soft ocean waves and a low horizon in the background, photographed from a slightly low, close perspective with a vertical 3:4 composition. Use natural midday sunlight, soft skin tones, gentle highlights, airy pastel colors, shallow-to-moderate depth of field, subtle film grain, and the look of a nostalgic Japanese summer magazine photoshoot shot on 35mm film. Keep the image wholesome, breezy, sunlit, and free of text or watermarks.
